name: web-system-status-card-with-uptime-bars-and-incident-history-button
title: System Status card: API, Database, Auth and Email rows with status icons and long strips of green and red uptime bars
whatItIs: A white rounded card with a bold title and an Incident History dropdown, and four service rows each with a status icon (green check, yellow warning, green check, red circle), a name, a grey status word (Operational, Degraded, Down), a last-incident date and a strip of thin vertical bars in green with a few red ones.
whatItMeans: Clear and reassuring; strips of bars show history at a glance and red marks show incidents.
techniques: Show uptime as a strip of thin bars.
Use a status icon and word per service.

vocabulary.definition: A strip of small bars, one per time slot.
An icon showing operational, degraded or down.
A red bar marking a failure.
A grey date of the most recent issue.
